# DevCart Gemini Watermark Tool

> Official 100% client-side, zero-quality-loss AI watermark removal engine for Google Gemini AI images and Veo AI videos. Engineered and maintained by Lead Developer Vivek Dalvi under DevCart Technologies.

## Core Domain & Links
- Website: https://geminiwm.devcart-technologies.in/
- Video Tool: https://geminiwm.devcart-technologies.in/video-preview.html
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/vivek-dalvi/gemini-watermark-tool
- Official Company: https://devcart-technologies.in/
- License: MIT License (Free & Open Source)

## Technical Summary
The DevCart Gemini Watermark Tool is a privacy-first web application, browser extension, userscript, and Node.js SDK designed to mathematically invert Google Gemini watermark compositing equations.

Unlike destructive AI inpainting tools that hallucinate pixels or cause blur, DevCart's engine calculates exact reverse alpha blending:
`C_orig = (C_wm - alpha * C_src) / (1 - alpha)`

## Key Features & Capabilities
1. **Zero Quality Loss**: Operates only on watermark pixels, preserving 100% original resolution and color depth.
2. **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Runs locally in browser memory via HTML5 Canvas, WebAssembly workers, and WebGPU. Zero server uploads.
3. **Multi-Resolution Image Support**: 0.5K (512px), 1K (1024px), 2K (2048px), and 4K (4096px) in JPG, PNG, and WebP.
4. **Watermark Catalog Specs**: Supports 48x48 (32px margin) and 96x96 (64px & 192px margin anchors).
5. **Veo AI Video Engine**: Native Veo video text watermark detection with ONNX FDnCNN denoise runtime models.
6. **Automated Interception**: Real-time Gemini web app integration via Tampermonkey Userscript and Chrome Extension.
